newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady, but most thinly traded.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, but most thinly traded.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady but flat on Friday, traders said.
Gas oil stagnated as benchmark futures hugged Thursday's closing levels. Heating oil barges were talked at July IPE -50 cents/flat fob ARA.

High sulphur fuel oil barges were lower, beginning trading at a low $79 fob ARA then moving up to $80.50 and $81 by mid-day, a notch below Thursday's close. Low sulphur barges were offered steady at $96 but some buyers moved further down to about $91. Gasoline was steady with eurograde barges talked around $188 fob and regular at $183.
